ignoreValues.reason: Playwright spec: the literal '' appears inside an expect() failure-message string, not as markup. This test is what enforces the alt-text rule; no image ships from tests/.

User confirmed (Karena, Sept 2026): editorial timeline note cards with a 4px brand-gold left bar were explicitly requested. Also covers the gold rule beside the timeline quote (.hs-chapter__quote), a pull-quote convention.
The 2px radius is the end-cap rounding on .gold-rule, a 4rem x 2px gold divider bar. DESIGN.md's rounded scale governs surfaces (cards, inputs, buttons); a 2px-tall hairline rule is not one.
Decorative watermark numeral at rgba(255,255,255,0.04) behind the section, same device as Hero's .hero__watermark. It is a faint graphic, not type on the hierarchy, so the type ramp does not apply.

herstory.astro is bespoke by design: its file header records that it recreates the original about/herstory/herstory.css exactly, rather than composing from shared primitives. Its one-off sizes, greys and radii are that recreation, not drift, and tokenising them would change a page deliberately matched to the prior design.
